drug_name: Activated Charcoal, Causticum, Arabica Coffee Bean, Prasterone, Glycyrrhiza Glabra, Ribes Nigrum Flower Bud, Eleuthero, and Veratrum Album Root
brand_names: No widely recognized brand names are currently established for this specific combination product. Ask your pharmacist or healthcare provider for the exact product name you were given.
what_its_for: This combination product contains a blend of natural and homeopathic ingredients that are traditionally used to support digestive comfort, help relieve occasional nausea, vomiting, bloating, and stomach upset. Some ingredients, like Eleuthero and Prasterone, may also be used to support energy levels and overall well-being. Glycyrrhiza Glabra (licorice root) and Ribes Nigrum (black currant bud) may help support a healthy immune and anti-inflammatory response. Always follow the specific instructions provided by your healthcare provider, as the exact intended use may vary by product.
how_to_take: Take this product exactly as directed on the label or as your healthcare provider or pharmacist has told you. Most combination products like this come in tablet, capsule, liquid, or powder form. Swallow tablets or capsules whole with a full glass of water (8 ounces) unless otherwise instructed. If it is a liquid or powder, measure or mix it carefully following the label directions. Do not crush, chew, or break tablets unless the label says it is okay. Take with or without food unless your provider tells you otherwise. If any ingredient causes stomach upset, try taking it with a small meal or snack.
dosing: Dosing for this combination product will depend on the specific formulation and the reason it was recommended for you. Always follow the dose printed on the product label or the dose your healthcare provider has prescribed. Do not take more than the recommended amount. In general, adult dosing for combination herbal and homeopathic products is typically taken one to three times per day. Do not adjust your dose without talking to your healthcare provider first. This product is not recommended for children unless specifically directed by a pediatric healthcare provider.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double up or take two doses at the same time to make up for a missed one. If you are unsure what to do, call your pharmacist or healthcare provider for guidance.
storage: Store this product at room temperature, between 59°F and 77°F (15°C to 25°C), unless the label states otherwise. Keep it away from direct sunlight, heat, and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom or near the kitchen sink. Keep the container tightly closed. Keep all medications and supplements out of the reach of children and pets. Do not use the product after the expiration date printed on the packaging. If you need to dispose of unused product, ask your pharmacist about the best and safest disposal method in your area.
what_to_avoid: Avoid taking this product with other medications at the same time without first checking with your pharmacist or healthcare provider. Activated charcoal, in particular, can bind to other medications and reduce their effectiveness — take other medications at least 2 hours before or 2 hours after taking activated charcoal. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking this product, as it may interact with several of the ingredients. Avoid excessive consumption of licorice (Glycyrrhiza Glabra) if you have high blood pressure, heart disease, kidney disease, or low potassium levels. Avoid taking Prasterone (DHEA) if you have a history of hormone-sensitive conditions such as breast cancer, prostate cancer, uterine cancer, or ovarian cancer without first consulting your doctor. Do not take Eleuthero if you have high blood pressure that is not well controlled. Avoid this product if you are allergic to any of the listed ingredients.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor or healthcare provider right away if you experience any of the following: severe allergic reaction (hives, difficulty breathing, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat); chest pain or irregular heartbeat; severe stomach pain, cramping, or worsening of your symptoms; signs of high blood pressure such as severe headache, blurred vision, or dizziness; unusual swelling in your hands, feet, or legs; muscle weakness or irregular heartbeat, which could be a sign of low potassium especially with licorice root; hormonal changes such as unexpected hair growth, voice changes, or changes in menstrual periods (related to Prasterone/DHEA); or if your symptoms do not improve or get worse after using this product as directed.
when_it_works: The time it takes for this product to work varies depending on the ingredient and the condition being treated. Activated charcoal may work quickly (within minutes to an hour) for digestive discomfort or gas. Homeopathic ingredients like Causticum and Veratrum Album Root are believed by some practitioners to work within a short time, but results can vary greatly. Herbal ingredients like Eleuthero, Glycyrrhiza Glabra, and Ribes Nigrum may require several days to weeks of consistent use before noticeable benefits are felt. Prasterone (DHEA) may take several weeks to months for effects related to energy and hormonal support to become apparent. If you do not notice any improvement within the timeframe expected for your condition, talk to your healthcare provider.
special_populations: Pregnancy and Breastfeeding: This product is NOT recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Several ingredients, including Prasterone (DHEA), Veratrum Album Root, and Glycyrrhiza Glabra (licorice root), may be unsafe during pregnancy or while nursing. Talk to your doctor before using any herbal or homeopathic product if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Children: This product is generally not recommended for use in children unless specifically directed by a pediatric healthcare provider. Elderly Patients: Use with caution in older adults, especially those with heart disease, kidney disease, high blood pressure, or those taking multiple medications. Hormone-Sensitive Conditions: People with a history of breast cancer, prostate cancer, endometriosis, uterine fibroids, or polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) should avoid Prasterone (DHEA) unless specifically supervised by a doctor. Kidney or Liver Disease: Use caution and consult your healthcare provider before using this product if you have kidney or liver problems, as some ingredients may affect these organs. Drug Interactions: Activated charcoal can reduce the absorption of many prescription and over-the-counter medications. Eleuthero may interact with blood thinners and medications for diabetes. Always tell your doctor and pharmacist about all products you are taking, including vitamins, supplements, and herbal products.
